issue.title: chezmoi just check is not idempotent: pytest_cache/README.md trips fmt-md-check on repeat runs
issue.description: Repo: chezmoi (linked repo, opened via /sase_repo). Reproduction: from a clean chezmoi checkout, run 'just check' once — it passes (fmt-check, lint, test all green). Run 'just check' again immediately without any source changes — it now fails at the fmt-check stage: prettier --check --prose-wrap=always --print-width=88 '**/*.md' reports 'Code style issues found in .pytest_cache/README.md' and 'fmt-md-check' exits 1. Root cause: the 'test-python' recipe runs 'cd home/lib/xfile && ../../../.venv/bin/pytest test', but pytest resolves its rootdir from the repo-root pyproject.toml (not the cwd), so pytest writes its .pytest_cache/README.md at the chezmoi repo root instead of inside home/lib/xfile. That directory is listed in .gitignore (so 'git status' stays clean) but prettier's '**/*.md' glob does not respect .gitignore and still matches it, so any 'just check' run following a prior test run fails deterministically until the cache dir is manually removed. Impact: 'just check' (and thus 'just install'-adjacent CI-style validation) is unreliable for any agent that runs it more than once in the same checkout, which is a common pattern (e.g. run once, fix something unrelated, run again to confirm). Fix options: (1) add .pytest_cache to .prettierignore or pass --ignore-path .gitignore to the prettier invocation in the fmt-md/fmt-md-check Justfile recipes, or (2) pin pytest's cache-dir/rootdir (e.g. -o cache_dir=... or a rootdir override) so the artifact never lands at the repo root. Discovered while validating an approved plan (sase/repos/plans/202608/gemini_37_flash_antigravity.md) that only touched home/bin/executable_tmux_ai_window, home/dot_config/sase/sase.yml, and tests/bash/tmux_ai_window_test.sh in the chezmoi repo — this bug is unrelated to those changes; the first 'just check' run against them was clean, only the second (rerun after 'rm -rf .pytest_cache') failed until cleaned again.

payload.entry:
Fixed by epic sase-ns.6 phase sase-ns.6.4 in the chezmoi linked repo, commit 61d32ee4 'fix: ignore pytest cache in markdown formatting' (2026-08-16T21:08:57-04:00). Closed by that epic's land agent because the phase worker did not perform its plan-mandated bead bookkeeping.

FIX: '.pytest_cache/' added to the chezmoi repo's .prettierignore, which now reads '.luarocks/', '.pytest_cache/', '.venv/'. Option 1 from the bead's scope. Both prettier recipes in the chezmoi Justfile ('fmt-md' at line 63 writes, 'fmt-md-check' at line 81 checks) invoke bare 'prettier ... "**/*.md"' with no --ignore-path, so both pick up the repo-root .prettierignore automatically and stay consistent with each other -- the consistency condition the bead asked for.

VERIFICATION by the land agent on 2026-08-17, reproducing the exact reported regression in the linked chezmoi checkout: planted a deliberately unformatted .pytest_cache/README.md (long lines, irregular spacing -- prettier would rewrite it), then ran 'just fmt-md-check' -> 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'. Before 61d32ee4 that file made fmt-md-check exit 1 on every second consecutive 'just check'. Probe artifact removed; 'git status' in the chezmoi checkout is clean. Phase sase-ns.6.4 separately verified two consecutive full 'just check' runs pass with the pytest cache present.

NOT ADDRESSED (intentional, matches the bead's 'prefer whichever leaves the fewest surprises'): pytest still resolves its rootdir from the repo-root pyproject.toml and still writes .pytest_cache at the chezmoi repo root. The directory remains gitignored, so it never reaches git status; only prettier's glob saw it, and that is now handled at the ignore layer.
